tasks.title: Class, Object and Default Constructor
tasks.question: Experiment 1(a): Create a class, create its object, and demonstrate the use of a default constructor to initialize college details (ID, name, city) and print them.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate class definition, object instantiation, and default constructor initialization in Java.

files.name: DefaultConstructor.java

tasks.title: Parametrized Constructor
tasks.question: Experiment 1(b): Demonstrate the use of parametrized constructor alongside a default constructor to initialize student attributes and parse name components into first, middle, and last names.
tasks.aim: To implement parameterized constructors and string splitting in object-oriented Java programming.

files.name: ParamConstructor.java

tasks.title: Method Overloading
tasks.question: Experiment 1(c): Implement method overloading by defining multiple display() methods accepting different argument types (char, char + int, int + double).
tasks.aim: To understand compile-time polymorphism through method overloading in Java.

files.name: MethodOverloading.java

tasks.title: Constructor Overloading
tasks.question: Experiment 1(d): Demonstrate constructor overloading with default, single integer, single String, and double parameter (int, double) constructors.
tasks.aim: To implement multiple constructor definitions with varying parameters in a single class.

files.name: ConstructorOverloading.java

tasks.title: Universal Palindrome
tasks.question: Experiment 2(a): Check whether an input string is a palindrome using StringBuilder and the reverse() method.
tasks.aim: To reverse strings and verify palindromic equivalence using Java String and StringBuilder APIs.

files.name: palindrome.java

tasks.title: Names in Ascending Order
tasks.question: Experiment 2(b): Read an array of N names and sort them in ascending alphabetical order using Arrays.sort().
tasks.aim: To sort string arrays in lexicographical order using Java standard utilities.

files.name: sort.java

tasks.title: String Tokenizer
tasks.question: Experiment 2(c): Tokenize an input line of space-separated values, display total token count, compute the sum of integers, and terminate gracefully when a non-integer token is encountered.
tasks.aim: To parse delimited string tokens and perform type conversion with exception handling.

files.name: token.java

tasks.title: This Keyword
tasks.question: Experiment 3(a): Demonstrate the use of the 'this' keyword to access and assign instance variables while distinguishing them from local variables.
tasks.aim: To understand the 'this' keyword reference for current instance field disambiguation.

files.name: this_keyword.java

tasks.title: Super Keyword
tasks.question: Experiment 3(b): Demonstrate the 'super' keyword to access parent class member variables from within a derived subclass.
tasks.aim: To utilize 'super' keyword to resolve superclass field references in inheritance.

files.name: superExample.java

tasks.title: Static Counter
tasks.question: Experiment 3(c): Demonstrate static variables by incrementing a shared static counter across multiple object instantiations.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate static field memory allocation shared across all class instances.

files.name: staticCounter.java

tasks.title: Final Keyword
tasks.question: Experiment 3(d): Demonstrate the use of the 'final' keyword to declare immutable, constant variables in Java.
tasks.aim: To enforce value immutability using the final modifier in Java.

files.name: FinalKeyword.java

tasks.title: Method Overriding
tasks.question: Experiment 4(a): Implement runtime polymorphism via method overriding in a Bank interest rate hierarchy (SBI, ICICI, Axis).
tasks.aim: To demonstrate method overriding and dynamic method dispatch across bank classes.

files.name: MethodOverriding.java

tasks.title: Dynamic Method Dispatch
tasks.question: Experiment 4(b): Demonstrate dynamic method dispatch (runtime polymorphism) using superclass reference variables executing overridden callme() methods.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate polymorphic method resolution at runtime using base class reference variables.

files.name: DynamicMethod.java

tasks.title: Multiple Inheritance with Interface
tasks.question: Experiment 4(c): Implement multiple inheritance using an interface (Exam) combined with class inheritance (Student -> Result) to calculate percentage.
tasks.aim: To achieve multiple inheritance using Java interfaces and class extension.

files.name: MultipleInheritance.java

tasks.title: Access Specifiers
tasks.question: Experiment 4(d): Demonstrate private, public, protected, and default access modifiers in Java classes and their visibility across classes.
tasks.aim: To verify encapsulation boundaries and access privileges of class members.

files.name: AccessSpecifier.java

tasks.title: File Information
tasks.question: Experiment 5(a): Query file system metadata using java.io.File: test existence, read/write permissions, check if file or directory, and get file length in bytes.
tasks.aim: To examine file attributes and permissions using the java.io.File class.

files.name: FileInformation.java

tasks.title: Reading File with Line Numbers
tasks.question: Experiment 5(b): Read a text file line-by-line using BufferedReader and FileReader, outputting each line with its corresponding line number.
tasks.aim: To perform buffered line-oriented file reading using java.io streams.

files.name: FileReading.java

tasks.title: Word, Character and Line Counter
tasks.question: Experiment 5(c): Count the total number of characters, words, and lines in a given text file using BufferedReader.
tasks.aim: To calculate character, word, and line metrics from a file stream.

files.name: WordCount.java

tasks.title: Checked Exceptions
tasks.question: Experiment 6(a): Handle compile-time checked exceptions (IOException) using try-with-resources and catch blocks when reading files.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate handling of checked exceptions mandated by the Java compiler.

files.name: checkedException.java

tasks.title: Unchecked Exceptions
tasks.question: Experiment 6(b): Catch and handle runtime unchecked exceptions including NegativeArraySizeException and ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
tasks.aim: To manage runtime exceptions and prevent application crashes using multiple catch blocks.

files.name: uncheckedException.java

tasks.title: Thread.sleep() & Concurrency
tasks.question: Experiment 7(a): Create three concurrent threads printing 'Good Morning' (1s sleep), 'Hello' (2s sleep), and 'Welcome' (3s sleep) using Runnable.
tasks.aim: To implement multithreaded concurrent execution using the Runnable interface and Thread.sleep().

files.name: MultiThread.java

tasks.title: Producer Consumer Problem
tasks.question: Experiment 7(b): Implement inter-thread communication and synchronization for the Producer-Consumer problem using wait(), notify(), and a bounded queue buffer.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate inter-thread communication and mutual exclusion using Java synchronized methods.

files.name: ProducerConsumer.java

tasks.title: ArrayList Operations
tasks.question: Experiment 8(a): Menu-driven program to perform dynamic array operations: append elements, update element at index, remove element at index, and display ArrayList.
tasks.aim: To implement collection manipulation using java.util.ArrayList.

files.name: ArrayListDemo.java

tasks.title: Vector Operations
tasks.question: Experiment 8(b): Create, populate, and traverse a synchronized Vector containing String elements using capacity and iteration.
tasks.aim: To demonstrate synchronized dynamic collections using java.util.Vector.

files.name: VectorDemo.java

tasks.title: HashTable Key-Value Storage
tasks.question: Experiment 8(c): Store key-value mappings in a synchronized java.util.Hashtable and iterate through its keySet to display contents.
tasks.aim: To implement dictionary key-value storage using HashTable in Java Collections.

files.name: HashTableDemo.java

tasks.title: Stack LIFO Operations
tasks.question: Experiment 8(d): Menu-driven program to perform LIFO operations on java.util.Stack: push, pop, peek, check empty, and display stack elements.
tasks.aim: To implement Last-In-First-Out data structure operations using Java Stack.

files.name: StackDemo.java

tasks.title: Display Simple Message with Button
tasks.question: Experiment 9(a): Design a Java Swing GUI application with a JFrame, JTextField, and JButton that displays a greeting message upon button click.
tasks.aim: To implement basic event-driven GUI forms using Swing components and ActionListener.

files.name: swingExample.java

tasks.title: Factorial GUI Calculator
tasks.question: Experiment 9(b): Design a Swing GUI application using FlowLayout with input field, compute button, and output field to calculate the factorial of a number.
tasks.aim: To build interactive numerical calculator forms using Java Swing components and action listeners.

tasks.title: Simple GUI Calculator

tasks.title: Mouse Events Handling

files.name: Mouse_Event.java

tasks.title: Keyboard Events Handling
tasks.question: Experiment 10(b): Implement KeyListener to detect and display keyPressed, keyReleased, and keyTyped events with typed key characters.

tasks.aim: To implement error handling within an event-driven Swing GUI application for numerical division.

files.name: integerDivision.java

tasks.aim: To implement custom graphical drawing with radio button event listeners in Java Swing.

files.name: trafficLight.java

tasks.question: Experiment 12(b): Develop a Java Swing application extending JPanel that overrides paintComponent() to draw lines, rectangles, and ovals.
